headline: One set of revenue numbers that Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance all forecast from.
pitch: I build the revenue data foundation that a go-to-market team runs on, and then I use it. At flyExclusive I own HubSpot Enterprise architecture and governance, the attribution and funnel dashboards leadership reviews, and an LLM pipeline that enriches CRM records and scores leads to prioritize high-value accounts. For the last six months I've also run the retail sales team on an interim basis, which does about $10M in sales a month. I've consolidated our stack along the way, replacing Tableau and Airtable. Before that, at TRANZACT, I partnered with commercial and finance leadership on attribution, forecasting, and an A/B testing program that guided investment. I'm based in Raleigh, in the Eastern time zone, and I lived and worked in India for two years, so the travel to your team there is a plus for me.

requirements.need: Build integrated data models, shared metric definitions, reporting, and full-funnel forecasts
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I designed the CRM data architecture (lifecycle stages, required fields, ownership rules, deduplication, Master Data Management) that reporting, attribution, and lead scoring all read from, and built the pipelines between the website, CRM, warehouse, and ad platforms in SQL and Python. At TRANZACT I built forecasting models and measurement frameworks with commercial and finance leadership. On this site, one channel definition is enforced in code and every view reads from it.

requirements.need: Data models and BI capabilities across multiple functions, including beyond Sales
requirements.evidence: My work has served marketing, sales, finance, and leadership: funnel and attribution dashboards for leadership, conversational reporting interfaces that give cross-functional teams on-demand answers, behavioral-data syncs into Iterable powering 10+ lifecycle campaigns, and forecasting with finance at TRANZACT. Tools: SQL, Python, Databricks, Postgres, Tableau, Power BI.

requirements.need: Lead revenue intelligence and funnel strategy across acquisition, expansion, renewal, and retention
requirements.evidence: I built attribution frameworks at flyExclusive connecting marketing activity to acquisition, retention, and high-value segments, and redesigned the retail performance dashboards to show contribution through the funnel. As interim manager of the retail sales team I use that funnel daily. At TRANZACT I ran multi-touch attribution and lifecycle analytics. Expansion and renewal motions in a SaaS business would be new territory for me.

requirements.need: Develop stage-specific ideal customer profiles and turn insights into growth strategy
requirements.evidence: I built an LLM-powered lead-scoring model at flyExclusive that prioritizes high-value accounts for the sales team, and attribution work that identifies high-value audience segments. At TRANZACT I ran segmentation and an A/B testing program (50% win rate, 30% CTR improvement) that turned those segments into campaign changes.

requirements.need: Measure revenue initiatives and report performance, forecasts, and insights to executives
requirements.evidence: At TRANZACT I translated commercial data into executive recommendations on acquisition and pipeline growth. At flyExclusive I run the leadership-facing performance dashboards and the sales team's numbers. I haven't presented at the board level yet.

requirements.need: Turn data and competitive intelligence into positioning, messaging, and enablement content
requirements.evidence: I shipped a Python competitive-pricing app for flyExclusive's retail sales team that analyzes competitor and market pricing and directly informed the 2026 pricing tables and strategy. I also built AI proposal and agreement tools that put approved messaging in every rep's hands, and onboarded 10 sales reps and 5 marketers onto the CRM.

requirements.need: Experience with revenue operations systems (Salesforce, CPQ, Gong, Dialpad AI)
requirements.evidence: Deep in HubSpot Enterprise (every hub), plus Stripe Billing, Iterable, and a Plaid integration I'm building now. I'm also leading flyExclusive's move from HubSpot to an in-house tool. I haven't run Salesforce, CPQ, Gong, or Dialpad in production; the data modeling transfers, and I'd ramp on Azuga's Salesforce objects and Gong call data first.

requirements.need: Coordinate cross-functional initiatives, timelines, and handoffs
requirements.evidence: Led flyExclusive's website migration, HubSpot transformation, and Tableau and Airtable replacements across marketing, sales, and leadership, while managing the retail sales team on an interim basis.

requirements.need: Up to 20% travel to India, Tennessee, and customer locations
requirements.evidence: Glad to travel. I lived and worked in India for two years, working day to day alongside local colleagues and learning the language, so I'm comfortable working in person with Azuga's team there and across time zones.

requirements.need: 10+ years in revenue intelligence, BI, analytics, RevOps, or growth strategy; scaling a SaaS business with $50M+ ARR
requirements.evidence: Six years across marketing, CRM analytics, and revenue systems, most recently at fast-growing flyExclusive, and before that at TRANZACT. My experience is in private aviation and direct-to-consumer insurance, not SaaS, and short of the ten years asked for. What I'd bring instead is hands-on building: I write the SQL, Python, and AI pipelines myself.
